reading.statement: King James Bible (1769) resolves as 66 independently read books, 31,102 passage coordinates, and 1,477 cross-book relations.

coordinate_system.ordinal_policy: One-based, zero-padded, and ordered by witnessed source traversal.
coordinate_system.projection: SVG and canvas positions are non-canonical render projections.
coordinate_system.privacy: Public coordinates expose derived ordinals and opaque witnesses, never source prose.
